name: publish_dialog_variant
description: Add a fresh dialog to a happening of a scene (a variant: companion/SCENES.md "Variants"), e.g. when dialog_variants_heard says the learner has heard all its dialogs. The same situation (the happening's title, time, months and person), other words, another point of grammar, at the learner's level; a dialog of lani.scene/v0 (3-8 lines, the person's line first, a reaction on every wrong choice, optionally a count with {n}, a memory of its own). It plays the next time the happening comes, marked as the tutor's. Validates it with the scene; a tutor variant with the same id is replaced. Load the lani-studio skill before using. Say the learner {learner} and what agrees with them {m:…|f:…} (companion/SCENES.md, the learner in the content). A spoken line, a choice's reply and a turn's puzzled may carry "face" (happy, laugh, surprised, curious, confused, thinking, worried, sad, cross, shy, proud; never neutral, the resting face): the speaker's expression, only where the line carries a feeling (companion/SCENES.md, "Faces").

happening.description: The happening id in that scene

dialog.description: The dialog (lani.scene/v0: id, lines, optional count, memory, talk, sky_stays, fx_stays, months: a season of its own within the happening's)

note.description: Optional one-line announcement shown in the app
